title: P47 Session 2: NGO Impact Video Production (DaVinci Resolve, AI Video Gen, ElevenLabs, Claude)
goal: Edit and produce a video for an impact organization (NGO)
context: I will be editing a video for an impact organization for Session 2. This video will be for a different client and serve a different purpose than the one I edited in Session 1. I would say it’s around the same difficulty but I chose this task because of the need for AI. For the first one, I don’t use AI that much in my workflow and kinda had to force it in to even meet the 5 uses. For this, there are more opportunities to use AI. It’s not entirely forced for my workflow but I will likely be using AI more frequently than I typically would.

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: No I did not finish all of the steps because they take longer than an hour and a lot of the AI features I wanted to use are behind pay-walls. I have used them in the past with free credits that I get when I make an account but video generator tools are hard to find that create a free video for download. I went through 90% of the steps though. Also the majority of the AI tools I used were not through Claude because I have found that Claude is pretty limited, even with premium credits.

Step 2.step_action: Generate a script for the video based on the NGO’s sector work and donors. I used AI to generate the script.

nodes.label: Decide to draft the voiceover script with Claude
nodes.detail: She explains that since this is a policy/anniversary video, she needs a voiceover script; the NGO's founder was originally meant to speak, but she decides to use Claude to help draft a strong script instead.

nodes.label: Write a script
Request a 1-minute anniversary script with NGO specifics
nodes.detail: She asks Claude to write a script, specifying it needs to be about 1 minute long and celebrate Ifraj Zanzibar Foundation's 10 years of operation, covering its sector work, founder, and donors.

nodes.label: Claude drafts the full anniversary script with visual cues
nodes.detail: Claude produces a 1-minute script timed to voiceover pace (~150 words/minute), including bracketed visual cues, statistics (nine schools, twenty-one nurseries, thousands of children served), and a note flagging that a real nonprofit piece should use the NGO's actual archival photos rather than generic stock imagery.

nodes.label: Review Claude's response about full anniversary script with visual cues
Ask for a plain voiceover paragraph without visual cues
nodes.detail: She tells Claude to drop the visual-cue formatting and just give her a straight paragraph of voiceover text she can feed into a text-to-speech tool.

nodes.label: Claude reformats the script into one voiceover paragraph
nodes.detail: Claude returns a single flowing paragraph opening with "Off the coast of Tanzania, between the islands of Pemba and Zanzibar..." covering the Foundation's founding, decade of work, and closing thanks to donors.

nodes.label: Give iterative line-level feedback on phrasing
nodes.detail: Over several rounds she flags specific lines that sound too generic or "AI-ish" (e.g. "lies a community with a simple belief") and a sentence she finds incoherent ("We started with a promise to work hand-in-hand..."), asking Claude to fix the wording each time.

nodes.label: Claude revises the script through each feedback round
nodes.detail: Claude rewrites the flagged sentences each time she pushes back, converging on a final voiceover paragraph naming the Foundation's decade of work, its school/nursery/clean-water statistics, and a closing thank-you to donors and partners.

nodes.label: Review Claude's response about revised scripts
